build_gtn_python_bindings: build the gtn Python package with CMake extensions for graph transducer networks
build_cmake_extension_modules: build CMake-based Python extension modules for gtn including _graph, _autograd, and _utils
run_cmake_build: run the CMakeBuild class to compile gtn native extensions with CMake version 3.5.1 or higher
load_readme_description: load the README.md file to use as the long description for the gtn package
setup_gtn_package: setup the gtn package with seven CMake extension modules and Python bindings via setuptools
